title: About Me
description: I'm a Data Engineer with 2+ years of experience and a strong foundation in data analysis and machine learning. I hold a Master of Science in Data Science from Lewis University and a Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology from JNTU Kakinada.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Genpact, I took business problems from proof of concept to production: data preparation, feature engineering, model training and tuning, AWS Glue pipelines and deployment. I cut an algorithm's run time from 3 minutes to 1, improved GPU utilization for model training by 22%, and raised a Random Forest classifier's accuracy from 78% to 86% with Bayesian Optimization.
